candidate_evidence.quote: [OTHER] Summary PIS and Online Video Modules: Complex trial information presented in alternative and more accessible formats

coder_notes: Behavioural informed-consent trial (summary PIS plus online videos); no drug or biologic intervention, phase NA. Patients are those considering early-phase oncology IITs; GBM patients named in inclusion criteria only for a non-randomised secondary analysis (ICE-CAP GBM cohorts), hence basket_gbm_eligible, but the population is not being treated with any anticancer agent in this study. Fails S6 (no pharmacological candidate) regardless of S5. Control arm is registered as PLACEBO_COMPARATOR.
